claims: New York City FC defeated the Colorado Rapids 3-1 on March 14, 2026 at Yankee Stadium
New York City FC has a 3-0-1 record
Nicolás Fernández Mercau scored a brace
Talles Magno added a late goal
Darren Yapi scored for the Colorado Rapids
The match venue was Yankee Stadium, New York City
NYCFC scorers were Nicolás Fernández (brace) and Talles Magno
Colorado Rapids scorer was Darren Yapi
New York City FC's win brings them to the top of the Eastern Conference early in the 2026 season
The Colorado Rapids played on the road in chilly conditions at Yankee Stadium
